sources.title: Ekko Build Guides :: League of Legends Strategy Builds, Runes, Items, and Abilities :: Patch 26.19

passive.name: Z-Drive Resonance
passive.text: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.

spells.name: Timewinder
spells.text: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that expands into a time-distortion field upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing and damaging anyone caught inside. After a delay, the grenade rewinds back to Ekko, dealing damage on its return.

spells.name: Parallel Convergence
spells.text: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.

spells.name: Phase Dive
spells.text: Ekko rolls evasively while charging up his Z-Drive. His next attack deals bonus damage and warps reality, teleporting him to his target.

spells.name: Chronobreak
spells.text: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.

damage.value: Ekko deals burst magic damage when his third Resonance stack triggers and when Timewinder hits on its return.

archetype.value: Ekko plays as an assassin, using Phase Dive to reach a target and Chronobreak to escape or deal damage.

axis.value: Ekko can use his W shield for short trades and push waves after level 7 instead of trading.

winCondition.value: Ekko wins by using his waveclear to leave lane and influence the map.

spikes.why: Ekko can deal more damage with Dark Harvest when he gains enough stacks and procs it multiple times in a teamfight.
Ekko deals bonus magic damage and gains movement speed when the target is a champion.

bait.why: Ekko cannot create an anomaly for a shield and stun while Parallel Convergence is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Ekko is heavily punished for mistakes because he is squishy and vulnerable to crowd control.
Ekko misses Parallel Convergence’s shield and stun if he does not enter its anomaly.
